He also seeks the beterment of the barrens and acts as sort of a gardiun for a local community center.\n\nIntelligent and charming (to a degree), his outward apperance hides a volatile man that yerns for revenge.\n\nMore likely to solve problems with intelligance, iginuity and the application of high force magic",
  "description": "",
  "background": "Born Jordan Martin Mallory West, to Samantha West and John Maximilian West. Both of his parents were successful investment bankers, this meant as a child his life was pleasant but uneventful. \n\nThis changed when he turned 13 and he awakened. An exceptionally smart kid, his parents decided to bring in a hermetic mage to give him private tutelage were he learnt the basics spellcasting, summoning and the arcane. During this time he also learnt the theoretical underpinnings of magic\n\nAfter this, his parents sent him to College in Maryland. There he took classes in Zoology, Parazoology and Magical threats. Here he also focused and refined his skills in spellcasting and summoning.\n\nAfter this, at the age of 18, he went to Seattle University where he took classes in magical security and combat magic. His future as a successful and well-payed security mage seemed almost guaranteed.\n\nThis was until the unthinkable happened and the 2.0 crash destroyed his SIN. Leaving him with no money or legal rights. Because of this, he had to leave the university and use the last UCAS dollars he had to rent an apartment in Redmond that doesn\u0027t ask too many questions.\n\nTo make money to live on, he started to work for a local fixer called Forge. Filling the role of combat mage on teams. It was during this time he meets a runner called Bomb. An elf muscle who he eventually had feelings for and moved in with.\n\n\nSoma and Bomb when not running became self-appointed protectors of the appointed protectors of there apartment block they were living in. They started to notice that large amounts of people would go missing from the building and that new shady figures were hanging around the place. they decided to follow and tail these guys and found that they were kidnapping people from the building and taking them to an abandoned factory to chop up and sell off there ware.\n\nDuring an unsuccessful assault on the factory, Soma and Bomb were subdued. When he came too, Soma found himself in an ice bath, a bullet in his gut. As he looked around, he saw a man with a sack hood over his head stood over the dead and carved up Bomb. \n\nWith his final ounces of energy, he throws a high force napalm at this man and makes his escape. Swearing revenge on the organleggers that did this to him and Bomb.\n\nWhen he\u0027s not doing that, he\u0027s running for his fixer or working in the local community centre.",

  "background": "Born Jordan Martin Mallory West, to Samantha West and John Maximilian West.
